plans.idea: Classic banner split: a left message column (logo, then the two-line headline and subhead, then Shop Now aligned to the same left edge) and a right product stage where the glow and the bottle sit side by side as one visual group.
Left-to-right reading strip: imagery leads on the left, the headline block fills the center, and a right-hand action column stacks the logo over Shop Now so the brand signs off next to the CTA.
Product-centered triptych: message on the left, glow and bottle as a centerpiece in the middle, and Shop Now alone on the far right as the final beat of the left-to-right read.
